repository.name: hawker-heroes
repository.description: Hawker Heroes mobile game - Pixel Kampung

issues.title: Save-file corruption on Android after backgrounding
issues.body:
Playtesters on Android 13+ lost their run after backgrounding the app during a level. The save writer was closing the file before the async flush finished, so the JSON ended up truncated.

Fixed in build 0.9.6 by writing to a temp file and renaming it atomically. Arjun verified on a Pixel 6a and a Samsung A14. Closing this one.

issues.title: Update studio splash screen to the new logo
issues.body:
The old logo is still on the splash screen. New export from the brand folder is in the shared drive.

Done, shipped in 0.6.1.

issues.title: Remove debug telemetry from the menu scene
issues.body:
The menu is still logging every button press to the console. Strip it before the beta build.

Removed in 0.5.9.

issues.title: Credits screen misspells the sound designer's name
issues.body: Small typo in the credits. Fixed and rebuilt.

issues.title: Level 5 difficulty needs a decision
issues.body:
19 of the 29 playtesters who reached level 5 quit there. Mei says the wall is intentional; Daniel says streamers will bounce. We ran out of time in the playtest review and have not decided whether to tune the boss or move the checkpoint.

See #playtest-feedback in Mattermost for the thread.

issues.title: Frame rate drops below 30fps on low-end Android in the night market
issues.body:
On a Redmi 9A the night market level sits around 24-28fps once the lantern particles start. Suspect the particle system is spawning too many quads.

Repro: level 8, low quality preset, walk into the night market.

issues.title: Tamil strings overflow the order button
issues.body: The Tamil translation for "Serve now" is wider than the button and gets clipped on small phones. Need either a shorter string or an auto-shrink rule.

issues.title: Booth demo build checklist
issues.body:
Before Indie Arcade SG:

- Lock a demo build with the save fix.
- Charge the two demo phones and bring the battery packs.
- Load the offline build so convention wifi cannot ruin the demo.
- Print the QR code for the wishlist page.
- Confirm booth size with the organiser.
